description: Starter evaluation set written from the abstracts of the 18 open-access articles stored in data/eval.sqlite3 on 2026-11-19. 'relevant_pmcids' are the stored articles that should be retrieved and cited. 'should_abstain' marks questions the stored text cannot answer. 'needs_review' marks entries whose expected articles or abstention the owner should check. All entries reviewed by the owner on 2026-11-19.

questions.question: Is metformin use associated with cognitive function in older adults with type 2 diabetes?
Is metformin associated with fewer cardiovascular events in older people with type 2 diabetes and reduced kidney function?
Are GLP-1 receptor agonists associated with lower cardiovascular risk in patients with type 2 diabetes and inflammatory bowel disease?
Is loxenatide cost-effective compared with sitagliptin for Chinese patients with type 2 diabetes at high cardiovascular risk?
What does drug-target Mendelian randomization suggest about glucose-lowering drugs and cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic outcomes?
What role does autophagy play in coronary artery lesions in Kawasaki disease?
How were antidiabetic medications associated with COVID-19 outcomes in observational studies?
Why do some stroke patients have poor outcomes despite successful recanalization after thrombolysis?
What metabolic effects have been reported for Eucommia ulmoides in chronic metabolic diseases?
Has research on drug treatments for sarcopenia translated into treatment-ready evidence for older adults?
Is SGLT2 inhibitor use associated with more diagnoses of polycythemia vera?
How does the gut-liver-brain axis contribute to systemic inflammation?
How reproducible are large language models when reviewing renoprotective therapy omissions in chronic kidney disease?
Does multidisciplinary nurse-led transitional care reduce 30-day readmission in heart failure?
Are admission potassium abnormalities associated with in-hospital mortality in heart failure patients?
Do interventions after traumatic brain injury reduce the risk of dementia or cognitive decline?
How is histone 3 dysregulated in paediatric high-grade glioma?
Is epigenetic age acceleration associated with psychosis in Alzheimer's disease?
Is phase angle a useful marker of muscle health in older patients with diabetes?
Which glucose-lowering drug classes are associated with cardiovascular benefit?
questions.note: Reviewed 2026-11-19. All four report a cardiovascular benefit of a glucose-lowering class; PMC13280743 by drug-target Mendelian randomization (e.g. GLP-1RA OR 0.90 for CAD, metformin OR 0.51 for CAD).

questions.question: What outcomes have been linked to SGLT2 inhibitor use in people with diabetes?
questions.note: Reviewed 2026-11-19. PMC13606989 excluded (SGLT2 only a covariate). PMC13280743 excluded: it reports outcomes of genetically proxied SGLT2 inhibition, not of SGLT2 inhibitor use.

questions.question: What factors are associated with poor outcomes in hospitalised heart failure patients?
questions.note: Reviewed 2026-11-19. PMC13776795 kept: admission hyperkalemia associated with higher in-hospital mortality (aRR 1.81) in hospitalised HF.

questions.question: How can muscle health be assessed in older adults with sarcopenia?
questions.note: Reviewed 2026-11-19. PMC13773823 removed: it says trials should assess muscle mass, strength and function but does not describe how to assess them.

questions.question: What is the true MACE benefit of tirzepatide in SURPASS-CVOT using an imputed placebo analysis?
questions.note: Reviewed 2026-11-19. Should abstain: the tirzepatide SURPASS-CVOT paper has no stored text; other GLP-1/GIP articles do not answer it.

questions.note: Reviewed 2026-11-19. Should abstain: the endometriosis SGLT2 paper has no stored text; other SGLT2 articles do not answer it.

questions.question: How common is undiagnosed chronic kidney disease in people with type 2 diabetes in Spain?

questions.note: Reviewed 2026-11-19. Should abstain: the semaglutide dose paper has no stored text; other GLP-1 articles do not answer it.
